name: Smartoptics Group AS
summary: Founded in 1990 and based in Oslo, Norway, Smartoptics Group AS specializes in delivering sophisticated optical networking solutions and equipment. Its extensive product range features flexible open line systems, passive optical multiplexers, OADM units, Layer 1 transport transponders, and a diverse array of optical and certified FC transceivers. Beyond hardware, Smartoptics provides essential support services, including technical assistance, extended warranties, expedited product replacement, comprehensive care, network design, and installation staging. These offerings are primarily utilized for metropolitan and regional network applications, serving a broad customer base that includes enterprises, government organizations, cloud providers, internet exchange points, and both cable and telecommunications operators. The company distributes its solutions globally through its dedicated sales force and a robust ecosystem of partners, such as distributors, OEMs, and VARs. Smartoptics Group AS operates as a subsidiary of Smarter Holding AS.
